type_scale.code_font_family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

anti_patterns: Do not reuse the Neotoma app/Inspector's own warm cream/terracotta palette on a public product page — decision public_pages_do_not_reuse_inspector_palette (DECIDED 2026-09-15, plan ent_98ef9d45f8a6896fed408f8f): it is a recognizable AI-generated design signature and these pages are handed to strangers (e.g. AI Summit Barcelona business-card QR). Each product gets its own deliberate, distinct accent + typeface identity built on the shared structural system, not a copy of the app's own look. This is the rule that made the prior version of this entity stale: it described a blue/red, no-serif, sharp-corner palette that matched neither product's actual shipped page.

Do not describe this entity's palette/type fields as if ONE set of values applies to both products — they do not; color_palette and type_scale are per-product. Only spacing_system and border_radius are shared verbatim.

No unstyled system-UI-only type stack for headings on either product — both pair a distinctive display font (Fraunces / Space Grotesk) with a plain sans body, never a single generic sans for everything.
No sharp 0-2px corners — both products use 10px card/panel radius and 8px button radius; only the fully-rounded (999px) toggle pill is an exception.

Do not silently reconcile a mismatch between this entity and a live served page — the 2026-09-21 build-landing-page runs (Ateles ent_48b0cb1115898ddc730c78bd, Neotoma ent_189a531c49bfc35d983e1135) correctly flagged the drift in their stage-4 gaps instead of overwriting it unilaterally; this correction is the reconciliation those two runs deferred.

border_radius.note: Verified 2026-09-22 identical on both served pages. Supersedes the prior 'sharp corners, 2px max' rule, which matches neither live page.

positioning_principles: One shared structural system, two product themes: spacing scale, radius, layout grid, and component patterns (.cap, .card, .tier/.panel, .tw-toggle, .hanchor, footer .noun) are shared verbatim; accent colour, ink/paper hues, and typeface family carry each product's distinct identity per decision public_pages_do_not_reuse_inspector_palette

Warm, editorial, not utilitarian: soft paper backgrounds (not pure white/black), a display/heading serif or grotesk paired with a plain-text sans body, generous radius (10px) and soft shadows on cards/panels — the opposite of a sharp-cornered inspector aesthetic

Accent as the single differentiator: each product reads as itself through ONE hue (teal for Neotoma, terracotta/amber for Ateles) applied consistently to CTAs, eyebrows, cap-ticks, and hanchors, not through structural divergence

Light/dark parity: every token pair is fully specified for both color-scheme states via :root[data-theme] plus @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark), toggled by the same .tw-toggle control on both products
Accessible density: base body size 16-16.5px, line-height ~1.5-1.62, max reading width in ch units (62-64ch) on prose blocks
shared.scope: Public-facing product pages (rendered_page entities for neotoma.io and ateles.co). ONE shared structural system — spacing scale, border radius, layout grid, component patterns (.cap, .card, .tier/.panel, .tw-toggle, .hanchor) and the light/dark toggle mechanism are identical across products — with per-product THEME tokens (accent colour, ink/paper hues, and typeface family) layered on top. Verified 2026-09-22 against both served pages' actual embedded CSS custom properties: shared tokens (--radius: 10px, --maxw: 1080px, section padding-block: 64px, .hero padding-block: clamp(56px,11vw,104px) 56px, .cap grid-template-columns: 10px 1fr / gap 22px / padding 28px 0, .btn padding 11px 20px / border-radius 8px) are byte-identical between neotoma.io and ateles.co; only --ink/--paper/--accent hues and font-family declarations differ. Does NOT cover the Neotoma app/inspector UI, which keeps its own warm cream/terracotta palette per decision public_pages_do_not_reuse_inspector_palette (plan ent_98ef9d45f8a6896fed408f8f) — these public pages are deliberately NOT that palette.

spacing_system.container: .wrap { max-width: var(--maxw); margin: 0 auto; padding-inline: 20px; } with --maxw: 1080px
spacing_system.note: Identical between neotoma.io and ateles.co as served — this is the strongest evidence the two pages are one system, not two.
